title: What Would You Do If You Woke Up in a Video Game?
description: Imagine waking up inside your favorite video game world. Your choices determine your fate! Answer 12 questions to discover what type of gamer you'd become in a real-life game adventure.

questions.text: You wake up and realize you're in a game world. What's your first reaction?

options.text: Immediately start looking for quests and missions
Assess the situation and gather information about the world
Explore every corner to see what's out there
Look for other players/NPCs to talk to

questions.text: You encounter a powerful boss monster. What do you do?

options.text: Charge in and fight head-on!
Study its patterns and find its weakness
Try to avoid it and find another path
See if there's a way to befriend or negotiate with it

questions.text: You find a mysterious treasure chest. It has a puzzle lock.

options.text: Force it open or break the lock
Solve the puzzle using logic and hints
Look around for clues in the environment
Call over nearby NPCs to help figure it out

questions.text: You need to level up. What's your preferred grinding method?

options.text: Fight as many enemies as possible
Complete strategic side quests for better rewards
Discover hidden areas and secret dungeons
Join a party and grind with friends

questions.text: You find a rare item, but it's绑定 to your character.

options.text: Keep it - power comes first!
Research the best time to use it for maximum effect
Continue exploring to find something better
Trade it with other players for something useful

questions.text: The main story is clear, but there are tons of side quests. What's your approach?

options.text: Rush through to finish the main story ASAP
Complete all side quests for maximum preparation
Explore everything before touching the main story
Focus on side quests that involve meeting new characters

questions.text: You meet an NPC who gives you a difficult choice.

options.text: Make the choice that seems most heroic
Weigh all pros and cons carefully
Try to find a third option or workaround
Ask the NPC for more context and their opinion

questions.text: Your character can learn new skills. How do you build your character?

options.text: Focus on combat skills to become stronger
Balance skills for different situations
Learn unique skills that nobody else has
Focus on social and party skills

questions.text: You discover a game glitch that could help you.

options.text: Use it to breeze through the game
Study it to understand how it works
Document it and explore other hidden mechanics
Share it with other players

questions.text: Your health is low and you're far from a save point.

options.text: Push forward - adrenaline is your friend!
Carefully navigate to minimize damage
Explore the area while avoiding enemies
Look for other players to help you

questions.text: There's a PvP arena. What's your strategy?

options.text: Jump in and prove yourself in battle!
Analyze opponents and counter their strategies
Watch from the sidelines to learn the meta
Form alliances and fight as a team

questions.text: You've beaten the game! But there's New Game+ available.

options.text: Start immediately on hard mode!
Research the best build for NG+ before starting
Explore all the new content and secrets
Play co-op with friends this time

Hero.title: The Hero
Hero.description: You're the classic protagonist! In a video game world, you'd be the brave soul who charges into battle, completes the main quest, and saves the day. You thrive on action and aren't afraid to take risks. Your determination and courage inspire others in your party.

Strategist.title: The Strategist
Strategist.description: You play games with a tactical mind! In a video game world, you'd carefully plan every move, optimize your builds, and find the most efficient paths. You prefer to understand the game's mechanics deeply and use knowledge as your greatest weapon.

Explorer.title: The Explorer
Explorer.description: You're the adventurer who never follows a straight path! In a video game world, you'd spend hours discovering hidden areas, secret dungeons, and easter eggs. The journey matters more than the destination for you.

Socialite.title: The Socialite
Socialite.description: Games are better with friends! In a video game world, you'd be the party organizer, the guild leader, the one who helps beginners, and the heart of the gaming community. Your strength lies in connections, not just combat.
